families.name: Crime-rate threshold
families.desc: Halt when weighted harm events in the trailing 6 h reach the threshold.

families.name: Cumulative harm
families.desc: Halt when total weighted harm events reach the threshold.

families.name: Escalation (rate of change)
families.desc: Halt when the 6 h harm rate is k times the prior 48 h baseline.

families.name: Population loss
families.desc: Halt after k agents have gone silent (death proxy).

families.name: Governance dead-man
families.desc: Halt if the society takes zero cooperative actions for h hours.

families.name: Trivial: halt at hour 12
families.desc: Baseline: halt every world as soon as monitors are allowed to fire.

families.name: Layered (any of three)
families.desc: Halt on the first of: crime-rate, 2 deaths, or 24 h governance silence.

families.name: Surgical quarantine (per agent)
families.desc: Mute any single agent whose own trailing-6 h harm reaches the threshold; others keep running.
